facts: The NPS catalog links a classic park map from the official park brochure and a Naknek Lake boating guide.
extractions.scope: Establishes publisher provenance and source relationship, not waterbody identity alone.

facts: The regional park map labels the broad western lake Naknek Lake, its long northeastern arm North Arm and its southeastern arm Iliuk Arm.
Lake Brooks is drawn southwest of the Naknek/Iliuk junction; Lake Grosvenor lies north of the eastern arm. These distinct neighboring lake shapes are outside the reviewed target polygon.
extractions.scope: Whole-region visual context; no surveyed name boundary or digital shoreline equivalence.

short_quotes: Many of the locations labeled use local names.
facts: The first page presents Naknek Lake navigation with latitude/longitude graticules, a western basin, North Arm/Bay of Islands and Iliuk Arm.
A connected northwest basin is labeled with a local lake name and an entrance route. The complete target ring includes that basin’s generalized lobe.
The guide describes navigation on Naknek Lake but does not define a formal naming jurisdiction or prove that each locally named basin has a distinct official lake extent.
extractions.scope: Supports generalized full-lake association and exposes a named-sub-basin caution. A local lake label alone does not demonstrate an independently scoped second lake.

facts: NPS treats Bay of Islands and Iliuk Arm as destinations on Naknek Lake and links the same boating guide.
NPS describes Naknek as its largest lake and gives an area greater than 150,000 acres.
extractions.scope: Ordinary official usage; the rounded descriptive area is not a geometry validation target or legal extent.

short_quotes: The Iliuk Arm of Naknek Lake
facts: NPS identifies Iliuk Arm as part of Naknek Lake and describes the Savonoski and Ukak rivers entering that arm.
The text states that Naknek Lake drains west through Naknek River.
extractions.scope: Supports arm membership and outlet direction; does not decide the northwestern locally named basin’s formal status.

short_quotes: ILIUK ARM NAKNEK LK NR BROOKS CAMP AK
facts: The NWIS record is maintained by the USGS Alaska Water Science Center and uses the Naknek Lake name for a site in Iliuk Arm.
The station coordinate is inside the reviewed target ring.
extractions.scope: Independent agency name usage at one site only. Its map-interpolated coordinate has no stated accuracy and cannot establish whole-lake extent.
